description:
AI notetaker for in-person and online meetings. Search meeting notes, transcripts, decisions and action items in 100+ languages.

Your company's know-how lives in people's heads and in meetings nobody can search. VoiceCap turns every meeting - online and in the room - into organisational knowledge your team and your AI can actually use.

Ask what was decided, who committed to what, or when a topic last came up, and get an answer that links to the exact second it was said.

Eight read-only tools: search across transcripts, summaries and decisions at once; list meetings by date, group or participant; open one meeting's full record; read any transcript window word for word; and pull decisions or action items across many meetings in a single call. VoiceCap also implements the standard search and fetch pair, so deep research can cite your meeting archive directly. Decision Memory tracks what a team has agreed across many meetings, so you can ask whether something was already settled instead of re-litigating it.

It exists because nothing handled non-english languages properly and nothing handled in-person meetings properly. VoiceCap records in-person meetings from a phone as well as online calls, and transcribes 30+ European languages and 100+ languages overall.

defaultPrompt: Summarize the meetings I missed last week and flag anything I should weigh in on.
What did we decide about the pricing change, and in which meeting?
Prepare me for my call with Acme - what happened last time and what's still open?
